verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a commerce product-data and affiliate API, so order lifecycle events are a fair axis, but the evidence documents no subscribable order events (created, updated, fulfilled, canceled). The only documented webhooks are for price-tracking changes, which is a different capability. Sale recording for affiliate payouts is not a programmatic order-event push.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent or backend can subscribe to order lifecycle events — created, updated, fulfilled, canceled — pushed programmatically
